text: At N=64 and N=128, force peaks at layer 1 (the distance layer), but in both N=256 seeds it peaks at layer 4 with a margin of only 0.03-0.04. Is the layer-1 force signal what disappears at fine sampling? Is the layer-1 force margin at N=256 near zero even though distance still peaks at layer 1 (margins 0.67-0.69)?
